title: fix(electron-demo): add nexus-plugin-slash tsconfig path mapping

commits.message:
fix(electron-demo): add nexus-plugin-slash tsconfig path mapping

PR #5 added the @floatboat/nexus-plugin-slash import and workspace dep
but missed the path entry in apps/electron-demo/tsconfig.json. The
demo's tsconfig redeclares paths (overriding, not extending the base),
so tsc fails to resolve the module in CI where dist artifacts are
absent.
